description: This file defines a class 'Other' in the namespace 'Opencart\Admin\Controller\Extension\', which handles extension management operations such as listing, installing, and uninstalling 'other' type extensions in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods for rendering extension list views, installing extensions, and uninstalling extensions, with interaction with models, controllers, and system components.

classes.name: Other
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'other' type extensions within the OpenCart admin extensions system. Provides methods for listing available extensions, installing, and uninstalling them, with appropriate permission checks and model interactions.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point that renders the list view of available extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and compiles the list of extensions, including available, installed, and their status, preparing data for rendering the view.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process of a specified extension, including permission checks, updating the database, and registering the extension's resources.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation of a specified extension, including permission checks, updating the database, and cleanup of resources.
